title: Deshaun Watson "ready for support" from Browns fans this weekend

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Deshaun Watson "ready for support" from Browns fans this weekend
sources.description: When Deshaun Watson was last on the field in Cleveland for a preseason game, he was serenaded with boos from the home crowd that he called "disrespectful" and "personal" in a postgame press conference.
